sloka: अक्षया नर शार्दूल जितालोका मया शुभाः ।ब्राह्म्याः च नाक पृष्ठ्याः च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान् ॥३-५-३१॥
transliteration: akṣayā nara śārdūla jitālokā mayā śubhāḥ ।brāhmyāḥ ca nāka pṛṣṭhyāḥ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakān ॥3-5-31॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)
